description: Securing funds from the Asian Development Bank for the implementation of the Mahaweli Water Security Investment Programme  - Stage 2 Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-05-26 to negotiate with the Asian Development Bank and co-financing institutions to secure funds for the implementation of Phase 2 of the Mahaweli Water Security Investment Program, including the activities of completion of irrigation infrastructure facilities in the North Central Province Main Canal and the establishment of a Commercial Agriculture Development Programme with improved distribution water systems in the areas adjacent to the North Central Province Main Canal. This project will support major irrigation schemes such as Hurulu Wewa, Mannakattiya Wewa, Eru Wewa, Mahakanadarawa Wewa, Nachchaduwa Wewa, Nuwara Wewa and Thisa Wewa, and will facilitate cultivation of about 17,500 hectares. Also, the drinking water provided through the project will benefit about 175,000 families. Out of the estimated cost of USD 536.5 million for the project activities of the said project, it has been proposed to finance USD 200 million through the Asian Development Bank. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to enter into a Loan Agreement with the Asian Development Bank to obtain the said loan amount, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding between the University of Colombo and the Ministry of Health of the Republic of Maldives with the objective of Academic Collaboration
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the University of Colombo and the Republic of Maldives with a view to enhancing cooperation in the field of postgraduate education and providing training for doctors and dental surgeons of the Maldives in Sri Lanka. In addition to the health professional training programme, it is expected to obtain the assistance of the Postgraduate Institute of Medicine in Sri Lanka to recruit specialist medical practitioners required for the Maldives on a short-term or long-term basis in accordance with a separate Agreement to be entered into between the two parties. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to sign the proposed Memorandum of Understanding between the University of Colombo and the Ministry of Health of the Republic of Maldives, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting the land and the constructions of the University College, Kinniya in the Trincomalee district with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2017-06-20 to construct the University College, Kinniya in the Upparuwatta land in extent of 12 acres belonging to the Land Reform Commission in the Upparu Grama Niladhari Division of the Divisional Secretariat Division of Kinniya in the Trincomalee District. An amount of Rs.25.45 million has been spent on the constructions carried out for the college, as of now. Due to the circumstances that have arisen subsequently, the University of Vocational Technology (UNIVOTEC) has decided not to maintain the university college on that land as planned. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister, in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education, to halt the further construction activities of the University College, Kinniya and to vest the land allocated for the University College and its constructions with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism for the implementation of a project in the tourism sector, as proposed at the Trincomalee District Coordinating Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to the Post of Deputy Secretary to the Treasury
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Mr. D.A.P. Abeysekara, a Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Planning Service, who served in a Post of Deputy Secretary to the Treasury, has retired from the Public Service from 2025-11-13 upon the completion of 60 years of age. Accordingly, Mr. S.S. Mudalige, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Planning Service, presently serving as the Director General of the Department of Project Management and Monitoring, has been identified as suitable for the vacant post of Deputy Secretary to the Treasury. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to appoint Mr. S.S. Mudalige, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Planning Service, to the vacant post of Deputy Secretary to the Treasury with immediate effect, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of ‘Rebuilding Sri Lanka Fund’
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka has faced a severe cyclone named 'Ditwa', during the last few days resulting in the loss of hundreds of lives. Further, private and public properties in large extent and infrastructure including highways, bridges, railway tracks, reservoirs, dams, irrigation systems have been severely damaged. As a result, general livelihood has been completely disrupted, and a number of rural industries including paddy cultivation and vegetable cultivation, as well as the fishing industry have been affected. A state of public emergency has been declared across the country as of now, and the affected people are staying in temporary shelters. Beyond the loss of life and property, the heavy rains and floods caused by the cyclone have disrupted services such as water supply, electricity and communication in many areas. Although, the Government is taking measures to expeditiously provide essential services to the affected people with the help of the tri-forces, police, disaster management centers and national and regional administrations, it has been found that these services are not adequate due to the severity of the damage. Although the Government has already allocated Rs.3 billion for emergency disaster relief, it seems that this amount is not sufficient to restore the damage caused to housing, infrastructure, agricultural lands, fisheries and essential services across the country. Therefore, Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. President to establish a fund called the 'Rebuilding Sri Lanka Fund' as a statutory fund operating under the Presidential Secretariat, to receive contributions from donors through a dedicated bank account designated for the said purpose, and to implement a comprehensive mechanism to take necessary steps to restore the lives and livelihoods of the affected people by taking the contributions already received in the accounts of the Treasury and the Central Bank of Sri Lanka as the initial capital of the proposed fund.

description: Entering into a Grant Financing Agreement with the European Union for the implementation of the ‘AgriGreen Initiative’- Green Economic Growth through Sustainable Agricultural practices
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of Plantations and Community Infrastructure, the Department of Rubber Development and the Rubber Research Institute have prepared a project proposal to implement AgriGreen Initiatives for green economic growth through sustainable agricultural practices in the Western, Sabaragamuwa, Uva, Eastern, Southern, Central and North-Central Provinces, where rubber cultivation is widespread. The said project is expected to be implemented with a Grant of EUR 8 million from the European Union, and the (GIZ) has been selected by the European Union as the lead implementing agency. The objectives of the project are to support the transformation towards green economic growth where sustainable consumption and production practices and food security are ensured, and to catalyze a shift to more sustainable and environmentally sound agricultural practices in selected production chains, with a special focus on youth and women. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to enter into a Grant Financing Agreement with the European Union to obtain a Grant of EUR 8 million for the implementation of the 'AgriGreen Initiative - Green Economic Growth through Sustainable Agricultural Practices' project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing urgent relief to people affected by the emergency disaster situation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Considering the emergency situation that has arisen due to the adverse weather condition, the Government has declared an extended disaster emergency situation with effect from 2025‑11‑21, until further notice. The Secretary to the Treasury has issued the Budget Circular No.05/2025, with the concurrence of the National Procurement Commission, including necessary instructions to the District Secretaries and Divisional Secretaries on the methodology to be followed in the provision of emergency relief and facilities required to restore the living condition of the people affected by the said disaster situation together, and Budget Circular No.06/2025, authorizing all the Secretaries to Ministries and Chief Secretaries of Provinces to carry out necessary procurement activities without hindrance. Additional provisions amounting to Rs.550 million have already been made in addition to the provisions allocated in the budget estimates 2025 for disaster relief services and emergency response. Similarly, approval has been granted to increase the amount paid for dry rations to the families affected by the disaster from the previous amount of Rs.1,800 to Rs.3,600 per week, from Rs.2,100 to Rs.10,500, depending upon the number of family members. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to authorize the Secretary to the Treasury to take necessary action and to provide further necessary approvals, guidelines and additional provisions for the restoration of the lives of the people disrupted by the disaster situation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Final draft of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board (Amendment) Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Taking into account the complex challenges and competitiveness that may arise in the future owing to the rapid urbanization, severe climatic changes, increasing consumer demand and the changes to be faced with the implementation of emerging digital technologies, approval of the Cabinet has been granted on 2024‑08‑12 to publish the National Water Supply and Drainage Board (Amendment) Bill, which has been prepared to adapt to address those challenges, in the Government Gazette and thereafter, present the same in Parliament, but, action could not be taken accordingly. Considering the need to expeditiously enact the said Bill for the efficient performance of the functions of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board, the proposal made by the Minister of Housing, Construction and Water Supply to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter present the same in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Regulations under section 71 of the Value Added Tax Act, No 14 of 2002 to Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Simplified Value Added Tax (SVAT) scheme was repealed with effect from 2025‑10‑01, and a risk-based VAT refund mechanism has been implemented to enable eligible taxpayers to refund VAT efficiently within a short period of time. Regulations may be made under section 71(4)(b) of the Value Added Tax Act, No. 14 of 2002, regarding the method and manner in which VAT refunds are to be made. Accordingly, the Regulations made have been published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2460/44 dated 2025‑10‑31. The proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to submit the said Regulations to Parliament for approval in terms of section 75(3) of the Value Added Tax Act, No. 14 of 2002, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of an Accident and Emergency Treatment Unit at the District General Hospital, Trincomalee
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Although the contract for the construction of an Accident and Emergency Treatment Unit at the District General Hospital, Trincomalee had been awarded in the year 2017, the said contract has been canceled in the year 2019 owing to the poor performance of the contractor. Since the construction work of the building had been completed up to the roof at the time the contract was cancelled, it has been identified that it would be more appropriate to complete the remaining construction work as soon as possible. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to implement a new procurement process to select a suitable contractor to complete the said construction work of the Accident and Emergency treatment Unit at the premises of the District General Hospital, Trincomalee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the Contract for Ground Handling Services and Cargo Warehouse Handling Services for SriLankan Airlines Limited at the Shanghai Airport, China
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The International Air Transportation Association has published a Standard Ground Handling Agreement specifying the services required to be performed by a Ground Handling Service Provider for an airline, and Ground Handling Services mainly consist of passenger, ramp and cargo warehouse handling services. The contract for the provision of Passenger and Ramp Handling Services and the contract for the provision of Cargo Warehouse Handling Services for SriLankan Airlines Limited at Shanghai Airport, China are scheduled to expire on 2025-12-31 and on 2026-03-31 respectively. Bids have been invited from the licensed vendors operating at the said Airport following the limited international competitive bidding procedure for the provision of the above services. Accordingly, the following proposals made by the Minister of Ports and Civil Aviation based on the recommendations of the Standing High Level Procurement Committee, were approved by the Cabinet:

To award the contract for the provision of Passenger and Ramp Handling Services for a period of 03 years from 2026‑01‑01 to 2028‑12‑31 to China Eastern Airlines Co. Ltd., the substantially responsive sole bidder, at an estimated cost of CNY 27.929 million.
To award the contract for the provision of Cargo Warehouse Handling Services for a period of 03 years from 2026‑04‑01 to 2029‑03‑31 to China Eastern Air Logistics Co. Ltd, the substantially responsive sole bidder, at an estimated cost of CNY 5.167 million

description: Awarding the procurement for the supply of Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LP Gas) of Litro Gas Lanka Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Technical and financial bids have been invited under the two-envelop bidding procedure in accordance with the provisions of the Procurement Guidelines - 2024 for the supply of Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LP Gas) required for Litro Gas Lanka Limited for the year 2026. Accordingly, 05 bidders have submitted bids and after technical evaluation, 02 bids have been qualified for financial bid evaluation. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to award the procurement for supplying 380,000 MT (20%) of Liquefied Petroleum Gas to Litro Gas Lanka Limited for a period of 12 months from January 2026, to Geo Gas Trading S.A, based on the recommendations submitted by the Standing High Level Procurement Committee and the Procurement Appeal Board pertaining to the relevant bids, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the E-Invoicing System in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Although a real-time electronic invoicing system is not operated in Sri Lanka, E-Invoicing is being widely used by many countries to modernize tax systems, reduce tax evasion and improve transparency in business transactions. Therefore, taking into account international developments in the relevant field, actions have been taken to conduct an assessment to adopt an e-invoicing framework to be compatible with the Revenue Administration Management Information System (RAMIS) implemented by the Department of Inland Revenue for tax collection. Based on the findings of the said assessment, it has been identified as appropriate to introduce a secure Web Application Programming Interface - Web API facility as an initial phase in the implementation of the E-Invoicing system. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to seek the necessary services from NCS Solutions Pvt. Limited of Singapore to enhance the Revenue Administration Management Information System (RAMIS) of the Department of Inland Revenue enabling to provide the Web API facility for VAT registered persons, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revising the qualifications of Guarantors to be presented for obtaining loans under the Interest-Free Student Loan Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - An interest-free student loan scheme has been initiated from the year 2017 for students who have passed the Advanced Level to pursue government-recognized degree courses in non-government higher education institutions. At present, 23,162 students under nine intakes have been benefitted under the said interest-free student loan scheme, and of them, 5,772 students have completed their degrees by now. From the first intake to the sixth intake of the said loan scheme, the opportunity has been given to present a close relative along with the mother/father or guardian of the students as guarantors. Nevertheless, those conditions have been amended from the year 2022 so that students applying for loans must present their mother/father or guardian as the first guarantor and a person with an income determined by the bank as the second guarantor. In this backdrop, it has been reported that students who must necessarily obtain loans under the said loan scheme are facing inconveniences. At the preliminary meeting held regarding the budget proposals for the year 2026, the Hon. President has instructed to take steps to continue the said loan scheme and to provide the opportunity to present guarantors in a manner that does not cause any hindrance to students. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to provide the opportunity for students to obtain loans by presenting the mother/father or guardian as the first guarantor and a close relative as the second guarantor from the 9th intake of the said loan scheme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Commencement of new projects for the development of infrastructure facilities in State Universities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The Department of National Planning has recommended 16 project proposals submitted for the development of infrastructure facilities in state universities falling under the purview of the Ministry of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education and included in the Public Investment Plan 2026-2030 for implementation. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to implement the following projects during the period 2026-2030, with the objectives of improving the infrastructure facilities of universities to accommodate the academic activities of university students and to suit the courses they are pursuing and bringing state universities to the level of international universities, was approved by the Cabinet.

Constructing, completing and equipping of a Professorial Unit for the Faculty of Medicine, University of Moratuwa - Estimated Project Cost Rs.3,594.14 million.
Providing hostel facilities for university students - Estimated Project Cost Rs.26,625 million.
Renovation of hostels at the University of Peradeniya - Estimated Project Cost Rs.2,452 million.
Construction of a sewerage treatment plant for hostels at the University of Vauniya - Estimated Project Cost Rs.219 million.
Construction and completion of the proposed building for the Faculty of Business Studies, University of Moratuwa - Estimated Project Cost Rs.1309.42 million.
Construction of a multipurpose building for the Faculty of Dental Sciences and the Faculty of Allied Health Sciences of the University of Sri Jayewardenepura - Estimated Project Cost Rs.3,419.38 million.
Expansion of the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering Building to house the proposed Heavy Structures Engineering Laboratory and Coastal and Port Engineering Laboratory for the Faculty of Engineering, University of Ruhuna - Estimated Project Cost Rs.1,453.97 million.
Construction of a Professorial Unit for the Faculty of Health Care Sciences of the Eastern University at the Teaching Hospital, Batticaloa - Estimated Project Cost Rs.2,279 million.
Upgrading the Canteen of the Faculty of Applied Sciences, University of Vauniya - Estimated Project Cost Rs.64 million.
Extension of the Student Canteen Complex of the Faculty of Dental Science, University of Peradeniya - Estimated Project Cost Rs.100 million.
Construction of a Health Center at the University of Vavuniya - Estimated Project Cost Rs.45 million.
Construction of a two-storied building for the University of Vauniya - Estimated project cost Rs.474 million.
Construction of a building with laboratories, workshops and lecture halls for the Faculty of Technology Studies of the University of Uwa Wellassa - Estimated project cost Rs.649.80 million.
Construction of a laboratory complex for the Faculty of Allied Health Sciences of the University of Peradeniya - Estimated project cost Rs.405 million.
Construction of a laboratory complex for the Faculty of Agriculture of the University of Ruhuna - Estimated project cost Rs.2,342 million.
Construction of a six-storied building for the Faculty of Management Studies of the Open University of Sri Lanka - Estimated project cost Rs.885.80 million.

description: Establishment of the Sri Lanka Consulate General Office in Chengdu, China
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Consulate General Office, established in Chengdu, China on 2009‑12‑15, has been closed with effect from 2016‑06‑30, with the approval of the Cabinet, due to financial and resource constraints that arose at that time. During the State visit of the President to China in January this year, the matter of reopening the said Consulate General Office was brought to the attention of the President during the deliberations held with the authorities of the Sichuan Province. Accordingly, having observed the geopolitical significance, economic potential, industrial and technological advancement, large-scale industries and trade and economic relations of the Sichuan Province, it has been recognized that the reopening of the Sri Lanka Consulate General Office in Chengdu will provide an opportunity to further enhance the existing friendly relations and cooperation between the two countries in the political, socio-economic and cultural fields. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism to reopen the Sri Lankan Consulate General Office in Chengdu, China was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of an Addendum to the existing Agreement with the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD) for the development of the Automated System for Customs Data System (ASYCUDA System)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Following the recommendations of the International Monetary Fund for structural adjustments with emphasis on automation in 1991, Sri Lanka Customs adopted the ASYCUDA System for revenue collection. Subsequently, the Government of Sri Lanka has adopted the ASYCUDA system developed by the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD). Five support Agreements have been signed previously between Sri Lanka Customs and UNCTAD, the sole organization providing expertise for the ASYCUDA system, for technical assistance and further development of the system. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to sign the 6th Addendum to the existing Agreement between Sri Lanka Customs and UNCTAD to extend the period of technical assistance provided by UNCTAD until June 2027, to upgrade the currently used ASYCUDA World system and to conduct two training programmes for relevant staff of Sri Lanka Customs on the functioning of the ASYCUDA and ASYHUB systems, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting of a block of land for the construction of buildings to provide hostel facilities for students and official quarters for the academic and non‑academic staff of the Rajarata University of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - At present, approximately 2,070 students are studying in the Faculty of Medicine and Allied Sciences and the Faculty of Agricultural Sciences of the Rajarata University of Sri Lanka, which was established in 1995, and about 150 academic and non-academic staff are serving attached to the said Faculties. Since those Faculties are located in a rural area adjacent to the Anuradhapura-Medawachchiya main road, on a land with limited space, providing suitable residential facilities while ensuring the safety of the students and staff has become a prime requirement. Accordingly, it has been planned to construct 02 student hostel complexes, 06 family-unit official quarters for academic and non-academic staff, 12 single-unit official quarters and 02 playgrounds for volleyball and netball. A block of state land in extent of 02 acres 9.6 perches located in Thannayamkulama Grama Niladhari Division of the Nuwaragam Palatha Central Divisional Secretariat Division, situated close to the said Faculties, has been identified as suitable for the relevant construction. The proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to vest the said block of land with the Rajarata University of Sri Lanka through a Free Grant in accordance with the provisions of the State Land Ordinance, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Gazette Extraordinary Notifications published in respect of Gem Industry, for approval of Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to submit the following Regulations/Orders published through the following Gazette Notifications, making relevant provisions to promote the gem industry in Sri Lanka, to Parliament for approval:

The Regulation imposed under section 6 of the Value Added Tax Act, No.14 of 2002, published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2461/43 dated 2025‑11‑07, enabling to apply Value Added Tax on imported precious gems/semi-precious gems, on a weight-based value basis;
The Revenue Protection Order No. 04/2025 made under the provisions of the Revenue Protection Act No.19 of 1962, published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2461/40 dated 2025‑11‑07, to create separate new National Sub-Divisions HS Codes for precious gems/semi-precious gems, enabling to apply Value Added Tax on imported precious gems/semi-precious gems, on a weight‑based value basis; and
The Order issued under section 3 of the Ports and Airports Development Levy Act, No.18 of 2011, published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2461/44 dated 2025‑11‑07, enabling the existing exemptions from the Ports and Airports Development Levy to continue under the same newly created new National Sub-Divisions Customs Codes referred to at above.

description: Amending the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No.11 of 2021
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the meetings held on 2025‑07­07 and 2025‑10‑13 to amend the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No.11 of 2021, including amendments for strengthening compliance, and monitoring of tax incentives, and institutional reorganization. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. The proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette, and thereafter submit the same to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing relief to fifteen employees of Kabool Lanka (Pvt) Ltd, Thulhiriya and to the employees at the Thulhiriya and Pugoda textile mills that were under the National Textile Corporation, who have lost their jobs and have not yet received compensation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Measures have been taken to pay compensation and other statutory allowances to the employees who were aggrieved by the closure of Kabool Lanka (Pvt) Ltd, Thulhiriya, and 15 other employees who have not received such compensation have made requests for their compensation entitlements. Further, as per the approval granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025‑06‑13 for the payment of compensation for the employees who lost their jobs in 1978, having served in Thulhiriya and Pugoda textile mills that were under the National Textile Corporation, 1,656 employees have been compensated as of now. Another 169 employees who did not appear at the initial stage have now submitted their applications. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Labour to pay compensation and other statutory entitlements to the 15 employees of Kabool Lanka (Pvt) Ltd, Thulhiriya, and to make payments to another 169 employees who lost their jobs having served in the Thulhiriya and Pugoda Textile Mills, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Registration and Licensing of Medicines (fees) Regulations, No.02 of 2017, as amended for approval of Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The National Medicines Regulatory Authority Act, No.5 of 2015, provides for the Minister in charge of the subject to make Regulations in respect of the procedure and the manner in which any medicine, medical device or borderline product should be registered, the terms and conditions applicable to such registration and licensing, and the fees to be charged for such registration or licensing. It has been found necessary to revise the Registration and Licensing of Medicines (fees) Regulations due to the reasons such as, changes in economic and financial values ​​that have occurred in Sri Lanka after 2019, the introduction of new technologies and testing methods, the expansion of the range of regulatory services, the maintenance of transparency of the National Medicines Regulatory Authority and the protection of international equivalence. Accordingly, measures have been taken to publish the Registration and Licensing of Medicines (fees) Regulations, No.02 of 2017, as amended, published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2023/30 dated 2017‑06‑14 by further amending the same, having published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2452/39 dated 2025-09-04. The proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to submit the said amended Regulation as per the provisions of the National Medicines Regulatory Authority Act No. 5 of 2015, to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Norochcholai - Wariyapola Transmission Line and Wariyapola Switching Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Several Transmission Development projects have been identified in the 2025-2034 Long-Term Transmission Plan prepared by the Ceylon Electricity Board and are scheduled to be implemented on priority basis. The Norochcholai - Wariyapola Transmission Development Project has been identified as a priority project to be implemented to utilize the renewable energy sources in the North Western region of the country. It is estimated that there is a renewable energy potential of more than 750 MW in the North Western region, and the objectives of this proposed Transmission Development Project are to establish a main transmission network to facilitate the integration of the variable renewable energy sources in that region into the national grid and to reduce congestion in the transmission network by transmitting possible bulk electricity generation around Puttalam. The estimated cost for the construction under the proposed project is Rs.24.06 billion, and the Department of National Planning has recommended that the project be implemented within the medium-term budgetary framework. It is expected to secure necessary funds for the project from the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Energy to implement the Norochcholai ‑ Wariyapola Transmission Development Project and to pursue action to secure funds required for the purpose from the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conducting remaining development activities of the Kelaniya Vidyalankara International Buddhist Conference Hall
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Vidyalankara International Buddhist Conference Hall building has been constructed as a sponsorship contribution by the Government for the national, religious, social and educational mission carried out by the Vidyalankara Pirivena in this country. Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025‑06‑23 to provide an amount of Rs.137.11 million for the year 2025, to restore the electric system of the said building. The restoration works of the electric system by the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau, utilizing the said amount, is nearing completion, and it has been reported that there is a balance of the provisions allocated for that work. The proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to complete all other essential components of the said building, including the fire extinguisher system, air conditioner system, construction of the security fence, within this year by managing the balance provisions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 3,000,000 inactivated doses of Rabies Vaccine (Human Use) of 0.5ml/1ml
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - International competitive bids have been invited for the procurement of 3,000,000 inactivated doses of Rabies Vaccine (Human Use) 0.5 ml/1 ml, which is used for the prevention of rabies. Four bids have been received for the same. Based on the recommendations of the High Level Procurement Committee and the Procurement Appeal Board, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the said procurement to Citihealth Imports (Pvt) Ltd. (Manufacturer: Serum Institute of India Pvt. Ltd., India) of Sri Lanka, for a total cost of Rs.360 million (excluding VAT), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the Contract for Widening and Improvement of the road section from 2+900km to 3+736km of the William Gopallawa Mawatha, Kandy to 4 - Lane Standard
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The road section from 2+900km to 3+736 km of the William Gopallawa Mawatha in Kandy, which falls under the purview of the Road Development Authority, is a vital corridor that facilitates daily commuter access and its improvement is essential to enhance urban mobility, reduce traffic congestion and help meet the growing transport needs of the area. Accordingly, bids have been invited following the National Competitive Procurement Procedure for the widening and improvement of the said road section to four-lane standard. 05 bidders have submitted bids for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to award the above contract to M/s. Maga Engineering (Pvt) Ltd, the lowest substantially responsive bidder, for a sum of Rs. 696.75 million (excluding VAT) based on the recommendation of the Standing High Level Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Sri Lanka’s Accession to the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - ‘The Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership’ (RCEP) is a comprehensive Free Trade Agreement (FTA) among 10 member countries of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) and five other regional countries viz. Australia, China, Japan, South Korea and New Zealand that have already entered into Free Trade Agreements with countries of the said Association. The Agreement came into effect on 2022‑01‑01 and 18 months later since then viz. July 2023, it was opened for accession for other interested countries. Under the said Agreement, the member countries shall take steps to fully liberalize tariffs ranging between 85% and 90% of their tariff lines. Accession to the said Agreement will enable Sri Lanka to diversify its exports and markets, as well as strengthen its participation in regional and global supply chains. Accordingly, Sri Lanka has submitted a Letter of Intent on 2023‑06‑28 to join the said Agreement. A preliminary questionnaire has been issued to several countries including Sri Lanka on 2025‑10‑24 in order to collect preliminary information to assess the compliance of the applicants with all the provisions and rules contained in the Agreement and their readiness and the preparation to deliver commercially meaningful market access in line with the aspirations of the Agreement and the questionnaire should be completed before 2026‑01‑25. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Trade, Commerce, Food Security and Co-operative Development for Sri Lanka's accession in the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership and for the completion and submission of the preliminary questionnaire provided to Sri Lanka, as necessary, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of the Agreement on the Mutual Recognition of Driving Licenses between Italy and Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A Bilateral Agreement on the mutual recognition of driving licenses was entered into between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Republic of Italy in 2011, and the said Agreement expired in 2021. Both parties have reached a consensus to update the Agreement, incorporating technical amendments thereto, and re-enact the same. As per the provisions of the said Agreement, a mechanism will be established for Sri Lankans residing in Italy for less than 06 years and holding a valid Sri Lankan driving license obtained prior to acquiring Italian residency to obtain an Italian driving license by way of conversion of their driving licenses and for Italian nationals residing in Sri Lanka to have their valid Italian driving licenses converted into Sri Lankan driving licenses. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to sign an Agreement between the two parties on the mutual recognition of driving licenses, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Suspension of the license issuing process for the implementation of the terrestrial analog system channels
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - 24 television channels, including 5 state media channels, are operating in the country using licenses issued to 16 institutions by now to operate channels under the existing analog terrestrial television technology in Sri Lanka. At present, television channels are operating using the maximum capacity of the frequency spectrum, and the Ministry in charge of the subject of Mass Media has initiated the Digital Terrestrial Television Broadcasting Project in 2025, enabling to implement a single digital terrestrial broadcasting system with the aim of providing a high-quality digital experience to television viewers under modern technology, instead of the 46-year-old analog terrestrial television broadcasting system. An Agreement has been entered into between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of Japan for this purpose, and the project is scheduled to be completed in 2029. Since the old analog terrestrial television broadcasting system is scheduled to be completely shut down after 02 years from the completion of the project, it has been observed that further issuance of licenses through the same is not effective. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Digital Economy and the Minister of Health and Mass Media to suspend with immediate effect the process of allocating frequencies from the frequency spectrum for the terrestrial operation of television channels by the Telecommunications Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka and the process of issuing licenses for the terrestrial operation of television channels by the Ministry of Health and Mass Media, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Agreement entered into between Sri Lanka and Luxembourg for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with regard to Taxes on Income
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka and Luxembourg have entered into an Agreement on 2013‑01‑31 to avoid double taxation and both countries are members of the Inclusive Framework of the Base Erosion and Profit Shifting (BEPS) Project. Member countries of the project are required to implement at least the minimum standards of the G-20 OECD BEPS Action Reports. Accordingly, the Luxembourg tax authorities have proposed several amendments to the above Agreement signed between the two countries in order to comply with the said requirement. The said amendments have been studied and agreed to by the Sri Lankan tax authorities, and an amended Agreement has been drafted accordingly. The clearance of the Attorney General and the observations of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism have been received for the said draft Agreement. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to sign the Protocol amending the Agreement entered into between the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Government of the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income, between the two countries and thereafter to submit the said Agreement to Parliament for approval in terms of section 75(1) of the Inland Revenue Act, No.24 of 2017, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Recommendations of the Finance Commission to Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the provisions of Article 154 of the Constitution, the Finance Commission has been entrusted with the responsibility of recommending the resource requirement for the Provincial Councils established in terms of the 13th Amendment to the Constitution and the principles to be followed in allocating the grants allocated to the Provincial Councils from the National Budget to each Provincial Council. Accordingly, the Finance Commission has submitted its recommendations to the Hon. President on the manner in which the Capital Grants should be allocated to the Provincial Councils from the 2026 National Budget and on the manner in which the Recurrent Expenditure should be set off.  The proposal made by the Hon. President to implement the said recommendations and to submit the same to Parliament in accordance with the provisions of Article 154R(7) of the Constitution, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to the Post of Director General of Irrigation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Mr. I.P.A. Gunasekara, presently serving in the Post of Director General of Irrigation, is scheduled to retire from the Public Service from 2025‑12‑04. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation to appoint Dr. (Eng.) K. Weligepolage, the most senior officer in the Special Grade Civil Category 3 of the Sri Lanka Engineering Service, presently serving as an Additional Director General of the said Department, to the post of Director General of Irrigation falling vacant, with effect from 2025‑12‑04, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Parliamentary Pensions Law (Repeal) Bill for approval of Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Policy approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2025‑06‑16 to repeal the Parliamentary Pensions Law, No.1 of 1977 of the National State Assembly. As per the pledge made by the Government to all Sri Lankans who supported its vision stated in the Government manifesto, ‘A Thriving Nation - A Beautiful Life’, a Bill has been drafted by the Legal Draftsman to repeal the Parliamentary Pensions Law, with the aim of abolishing the pension entitlements granted to the representatives elected to Parliament and their spouses. Clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the said Bill. The proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter submit the same to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the National Institute of Occupational Safety and Health Act, No.38 of 2009
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The National Institute of Occupational Safety and Health has been established by the National Institute of Occupational Safety and Health Act, No. 38 of 2009, with the aim of formulating a national policy to set standards for occupational safety and health. Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2023‑03‑07 to amend the said Act to expand the functions of the said Institute and establish an occupational safety and health culture that aligns with the current world of work. The Legal Draftsman has informed to obtain policy approval of the present Cabinet in order to proceed with the draft prepared for the purpose. Further, the National Institute of Occupational Safety and Health has observed the need to introduce further appropriate amendments to the said Bill enabling to formulate a mechanism which is monitored by the Public sector to improve the occupational safety of employees in the sectors not covered by the Factories Ordinance and to standardize professionals engaged in the field of occupational safety and health. Accordingly, taking into account the proposal made by the Minister of Labour to prepare the final Bill to amend the National Institute of Occupational Safety and Health Act, incorporating the said amendments, the Cabinet decided to grant approval to proceed with the same.

description: Presenting the Regulation made under section 66 of the Shop and Office Employees (Regulation of Employment and Remuneration) Act (chapter 129), in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025‑07‑03 to amend the Regulation No.3 of the Shop and Office Employees (Regulation of Employment and Remuneration) Act, No.19 of 1954. Accordingly, the said amended Regulation is envisaged to introduce the necessary legal amendments to enable female employees above the age of 18 years employed as Food and Beverage Stewardess in residential hotels and restaurants to work after 6.00 pm and before 6.00 am. The Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Labour to submit the amended Regulation made by the Minister for that purpose under section 66 of the Shop and Office Employee (Regulation of Employment and Remuneration) Act, to Parliament for approval and thereafter to publish the same in the Government Gazette.

description: Submission of Public Debt Management Regulations No.02 of 2025, to Parliament for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - As per the provisions of section 16 of the Public Debt Management Act, No.33 of 2024, the Public Debt Management Office has been vested with the power to issue Government Debt Securities. In terms of section 31 of the said Act, the Minister in charge of the subject of Finance has been vested with the powers relating to the appointment of primary dealers and issuance of Regulations regarding the matters connected with them. Accordingly, the Public Debt Management Regulations No.02 of 2025 made aiming to authorize the Public Debt Management Office to directly deal with the Primary Dealers and designated non-dealer bidders in the issuance of Government securities, empower the Public Debt Management Office to evaluate the performance of the Primary Dealers and to issue directions, operational guidelines, have been published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2459/52 dated 2025‑10‑24. The proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to submit the said Regulations to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Pipeline Project from Kolonnawa Installation to Colombo Harbour
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Imported petroleum products are being currently transported from the Colombo Harbour to the Kolonnawa Installation through 05 pipelines. These pipelines are rather old and frequent leakages have been reported over the years. Although proposals had been called previously to implement a project, taking into account the necessity of having a reliable pipeline system, it has not yet been possible to select a suitable investor based on those proposals. Therefore, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Energy to terminate the previously implemented procurement process and to implement the 'Kolonnawa to Harbour  Pipeline Project' as an Engineering, Procurement, Construction and Commissioning (EPCC) project comprising of the project components of construction of 02 piggable pipelines with a diameter of 18 inches and 14 inches from the Dolphin Oil Dock in the Colombo Harbour to the Kolonnawa Terminal, construction of a 12-inch diameter subsea pipeline section from the Dolphin Oil Dock in the Colombo Harbour to the Seram Gate, and necessary modifications of the terminals at the Colombo Harbour and the Kolonnawa Terminal.

description: Implementation of the Ranmihitenna National Tele Cinema Park productively through a private sector investment
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024‑07‑22 to select a suitable investor to implement the Ranmihitenna National Tele Cinema Park under the Design, Build, Finance, Operate and Maintenance (DBFOM) model. Further, the Officials' Committee appointed by the Cabinet under the Chairmanship of the Secretary to the Prime Minister to conduct a review on the State-Owned Non-Commercial Entities has also recommended for calling Expressions of Interest from local and foreign investors to implement the said Cinema Park under a suitable commercial model to increase its utility and revenue. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to implement the Ranmihitenna National Tele Cinema Park through a private investment under the Design, Build, Finance, Operate and Maintain (DBFOM) model for a period of 30 years, and to call for expressions of interest from interested investors following a competitive and transparent procurement process, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing residential facilities for Prison Officers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Due to the shortage of officers in prisons, many prison officers have to work after their regular working hours, and as such it has become essential to provide residential facilities for them. However, due to the lack of adequate residential facilities in almost all prisons, it has been found necessary to implement an expeditious programme to modernize the existing residential facilities and construct new residential facilities in places with ample space. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to improve the residential facilities for prison officers as follows on priority basis during the year 2026, was approved by the Cabinet:

Construction of two barracks in Welikada Prison.
Construction of one barrack in Anuradhapura Prison.
Modernization of barracks and improvement of sanitary facilities in all prison institutions.

description: Completion of 74 bridges identified under the Rural Bridges Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2021‑02‑08, has granted approval to award 326 contracts for the construction of bridges located island‑wide, to the State Development and Construction Corporation under the Rural Bridges Programme. It was decided in 2022 to stop the construction works of 184 bridges where constructions had not been commenced by then and construction works of 45 of the remaining 142 bridges have been completed by now. Works of another 23 bridges have been assigned to the Road Development Authority. The proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to have the works of 74 remaining bridges initiated by the State Development and Construction Corporation and expeditiously complete the constructions thereof, with a view to alleviating the difficulties encountered by the public in the relevant areas, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the Contract for the construction of the proposed seven storied residential building for the Sri Lanka Railways under the Kandy Multimodal Transport Terminal Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited following the National Competitive Bidding Procedure to award the contract for the construction of the proposed seven storied residential building for the Sri Lanka Railways under the Kandy Multimodal Transport Terminal Development Project. Five bids have been received for the same and four bids have been determined to be technically responsive. After the evaluation pertaining to the relevant financial bids, the Standing High Level Procurement Committee has recommended to award the relevant contract to Maga Engineering (Pvt) Ltd for a sum of Rs. 1.53 billion (excluding VAT). Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to award the said contract, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of Green Gram Harvest of the Interim Season of 2025
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Green Grams have been cultivated on an area of approximately 16,500 hectares in the Yala Season and Interim Season of 2025 under the programme for increasing productivity and production of Green Gram cultivation during 2025 implemented on the guidance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation. ​​ A harvest of about 14,600 metric tons of Green Gram is expected through this programme and out of which about 12,000 metric tons are expected to directly reach the local market. Currently, Green Gram harvesting has begun in the Hambantota District, and it has been reported that middlemen are buying the harvest at a low price of Rs. 450/- per kilogram. Therefore, the National Food Promotion Board, on the instructions of the Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation, has initiated a programme to purchase Green Gram harvest from farmers enabling to grant a reasonable price to farmers for their production. The proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation to provide the necessary provisions for purchasing Green Gram harvest in a competitive manner with the private sector by expanding the aforesaid programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of New Health Sector Project Proposals to enhance the health condition of the people
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Due to the economic crisis that affected the country during the period 2021-2024 owing to the COVID-19 pandemic, many healthcare projects have been temporarily suspended. With the recent improvement in the economy, the need to re-commence the suspended projects as well as to initiate new projects aimed at improving the healthcare status of the people has been identified. Accordingly, in pursuant to the Budget call for the year 2026, the Public Investment Committee has selected a number of new projects in the health sector for inclusion in the Public Investment Programme, giving priority to the implementation of the currently implemented projects and new initiatives included in the Public Investment Programme. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to implement the following 09 new projects, for which provisions will be made through the Budget Estimates 2026, in the ensuing year, was approved by the Cabinet.

National Oral Health Survey - 2025/2026.
Extension of the existing four-storied building for establishment of the proposed Operating Theatre, Endoscopy Unit and Cardio-Thoracic Pre-op Wards in the Teaching Hospital Kurunegala.
Construction of a five-storied building for Surgical and Maternity Care with Radiology facilities at the Matale District Hospital.
Construction of a five- storied building with OPD and Specialized Units at the Institute of Oral Health (IOH), Maharagama.
Construction of a five- storied building for the Institute of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology (JMO Office - Colombo).
Construction of Phase I and Phase II of the Accident and Emergency Treatment and Related Services Building Complex at the Teaching Hospital, Anuradhapura.
Construction of Consultants’ and Medical Officers’ Quarters at the Teaching Hospital, Anuradhapura.
Extension of Radiology Unit at the Teaching Hospital, Batticaloa.
Construction of the National Heart Center at the National Hospital, Sri Lanka.

description: Conducting the ‘Aqua Planet – Sri Lanka, International Expo – 2025’ in parallel with the International Fisheries Day
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Going beyond national exhibitions such as 'Minvisithuru Sri Lanka' and 'Seafood Fiesta', the 'Aqua Planet - Sri Lanka, International Expo 2025', which is conducted bringing together global fisheries professionals, researchers, entrepreneurs and enthusiasts, is scheduled to be held at the Lotus Tower, Colombo from 21st to 23rd November 2025. The exhibition is expected to highlight Sri Lanka's aquatic resources across fisheries resources, aquaculture, processors, exporters and ornamental fish farmers, paying special attention to the themes of sustainability, innovation, trade, education and the principles of the blue economy (Ocean Economy). Further, at the said exhibition, it is also planned to feature panel discussions on marine conservation, exhibition of sustainable technologies, business matchmaking sessions and workshops on topics such as circular economy applications in seafood processing. Accordingly, further attention will be paid for the opportunities of enhancing the country's economic output through the untapped blue economy (Ocean Economy) opportunities in Sri Lanka by integrating sustainable practices into traditional sectors. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Fisheries, Aquatic and Marine Resources to hold the proposed 'Aqua Planet - Sri Lanka, International Expo 2025' International Exhibition, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to the Post of Co-operative Development Commissioner/ Registrar of Co-operative Societies
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A request has been made by Ms. H.A. Asha Hapuarachchi, Grade I Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, presently serving as the Co-operative Development Commissioner/Registrar of Co-operative Societies, to release her from the said Post. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Trade, Commerce, Food Security and Co-operative Development to release her from the said Post and to appoint Ms. Tharanie Kumaradasa, Grade I officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, presently serving as a Senior Assistant Secretary of the Ministry of Trade, Commerce, Food Security and Co-operative Development, to the Post of Co-operative Development Commissioner/Registrar of Co-operative Societies that falls vacant, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Pilot Demonstration Models in order to introduce Piped Irrigation Modalities as a novel approach for Sri Lanka’s irrigation sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The persistent decline in crop yields due to prolonged droughts and the damages caused to the earthen canal systems as a result of increasing the intensity of rainfall have been identified as two major challenges faced by smallholder farmers in the dry zone of Sri Lanka. Therefore, it has been proposed to introduce piped irrigation water distribution systems instead of open type earthen canals which operate at low conveyance efficiency, as a solution to these challenges. Accordingly, a detailed technical study has been carried out to implement 04 pilot projects under 03 different piped irrigation modalities, covering an area of about 877 hectares, to demonstrate them as models. With the use of piped irrigation water distribution systems, it is expected to reduce the wastage of irrigation water from traditional open type canal irrigation systems, provide relief to farmers affected by water scarcity, direct smallholder farmers to high-value food crop cultivation, and increase women's participation in agriculture. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation to implement 03 pilot demonstration models in the Northwestern Province and another pilot demonstration model in the Uva Province, using the funds provided by the Japan Foundation for Prosperous and Resilient Asia and the Pacific (JFPR) for the benefit of the developing member countries of the Asian Development Bank and the funds amounting to USD 3.3 million provided  by the Asian Development Bank and another USD 1.68 million of the Government of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Universities Act, No.16 of 1978
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-06-16 to amend the Universities Act No.16 of 1978. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill drafted by the Legal Draftsman. The proposed amendments to the Universities Act No.16 of 1978 will enable to create a merit-based selection process by expanding the criteria with regard to the qualifications for appointment to the post of Dean. The proposed amendments are intended to broaden the pool of eligible candidates for key academic administrative positions in the university system, thereby strengthening institutional governance. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister, in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education, to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Annulment of the National Film Corporation of Sri Lanka Act, No.47 of 1971 and introduction of a new Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Almost five decades have lapsed since the establishment of the National Film Corporation and significant changes in the social, political and economic sectors as well as technology related to the film industry have occurred during that period. The need to revise the institutional structure and functions of the National Film Corporation to suit the present has been identified. An initial draft has been prepared regarding the structure and the functions of the National Cinema Council of Sri Lanka proposed to be established with the aim of creating a strategic direction in areas which are not covered by the National Film Corporation Act and carrying out the functions of film regulation and promotion of film culture. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill to repeal the Sri Lanka National Film Corporation Act No.47 of 1971 also incorporating the provisions for the establishment of the Sri Lanka National Film Council, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of a new Bill for Investment Protection
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The 2025 Budget proposed to introduce a new Act to achieve the objectives of preventing arbitrary nationalization of private assets including enterprises and properties, establishing an Investment Protection Council as an effective alternative dispute resolution mechanism and ensuring policy stability and predictability for investors. Accordingly, an Officials’ Committee has been appointed to prepare a Concept Paper for the preparation of a Bill. The proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill, based on the Concept Paper prepared by the said Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the Replacement of Petroleum Storage Tanks No.30 and 31 at the Kolonnawa Installation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Ceylon Petroleum Storage Terminal Limited has planned to maintain a stock of petroleum products sufficient for at least 45 days to be used at any eventuality. In order to meet the said requirement, the construction of 6 new tanks with a capacity of 64,000 cubic meters has been commenced at the Kolonnawa Installation of the Company, and the procurement process for the construction of 3 new tanks with a capacity of 40,000 cubic meters has been commenced at the Muthurajawela terminal. In addition, it has also been planned to replace the existing tanks Nos.30 and 31 at the Kolonnawa installation with new tanks with a capacity of 7,000 cubic meters and 15,000 cubic meters respectively. Accordingly, taking into account the need to replace fuel storage tanks Nos.30 and 31 with new tanks to ensure continuous supply of petroleum products, the proposal made by the Minister of Energy to initiate the procurement process for the said purpose utilizing the funds of Ceylon Petroleum Storage Terminal Limited, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Indoor Stadium in Jaffna
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that the promotion of sports activities and the development of sports infrastructure in the Northern Province, which is recovering from long standing social conflicts and challenges as a very important requirement. For this purpose, it has been proposed to construct an indoor stadium in the Jaffna District with the aim of developing indoor sports such as table tennis, tennis, badminton, netball and chess in schools and sports clubs. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports for the construction of the Jaffna Indoor Stadium with relevant facilities at an estimated cost of Rs.170 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Buses, Vans, Gully Bowsers and Tractors for the Department of Prisons
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The necessity for the supply of essential vehicle facilities to the Department of Prisons has arisen in order to carry out the relevant duties efficiently in directly engaging with the courts in relation to suspects in remand custody and accused sentenced by various courts in Sri Lanka and dealing with the welfare of those detainees. Accordingly, bids have been invited under the National Competitive Procurement Procedure for the purchase of 30 buses (44 seater), 10 buses (30 seater), 10 vans, 05 gully bowsers and 03 tractors for the Department of Prisons. 08 bidders have submitted bids for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to award the procurement for the purchase of vehicles for the Department of Prisons as follows, based on the recommendations submitted by the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee pertaining to the said bids, was approved by the Cabinet.
