description: Implementation of the Project on Local Authority Small Bridges Sustainable Improvement
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A broad need assessment on rural access infrastructure has been conducted by the Ministry of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government in collaboration with all Provincial Councils and Local Authorities based on the proposals for the improvement of small bridges submitted by the Provincial Councils. The said need assessment has identified that a large number of small bridges are in a dilapidated, narrow, unprotected or destroyed condition, thereby placing groups such as school children, farmers, women at particular risk. Accordingly, it has been planned to implement the 'Project on Local Authority Small Bridges Sustainable Improvement' with the objectives of ensuring a safe destination, reducing transport costs, enhancing market access, facilitating rural production, etc. The proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government to implement the said project from 2026 to 2029 at an estimated total cost of Rs.6,793.03 million, to sustainably upgrade 880 bridges that need to be upgraded within the jurisdictions of 229 Local Authorities in the 25 districts of the island on a priority basis, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Strategic Plan for Vidatha Resource Centres
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Vidatha Programme has been initiated under the concept of 'Technology to the Village', with a view to empowering the rural community with innovative technological knowledge derived through scientific research and 315 Vidatha Centres are currently operating across the country. The Ministry of Science and Technology has prepared the Five-Year Strategic Plan for the Vidatha Programme - 2026-2030 with the aim of implementing the concept of 'Technology to the Village', which had a less attention during the period 2021-2024, on a solid foundation. Further, the preliminary work to transform Vidatha Resource Centers into Mini Incubation Centres has already begun in collaboration with institutions such as the National Enterprise Development Authority and the Industrial Development Board of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Science and Technology to implement the Five-Year Strategic Plan prepared for the Vidatha Programme for the period 2026-2030 and to deploy one science graduate in each of 315 Vidatha Resource Centers located throughout the Island, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 28th Joint Asia Pacific Regional Social Work Conference
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - 28th Joint Asia Pacific Regional Social Work Conference is scheduled to be held in Sri Lanka from 18th to 21st November 2025 and 13 local representatives and 104 foreign representatives from 30 countries are scheduled to participate in the said Conference. Accordingly, proposal made by the Minister of Rural Development, Social Security and Community Empowerment to conduct the said Conference in Sri Lanka and to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the National Social Development Institute and the Sri Lanka Association of Professional Social Workers in order to establish the institutional collaboration required to conduct the said Conference, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Multi-Modal Transport Centres
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the national policy of the present Government to make public transport in Sri Lanka efficient and orderly, it has been found necessary to establish multi-modal transport centres with the necessary facilities, enabling to initiate Transit Cities and efficient public transport services from such Transit Cities to main cities through inter-coordination between transport modes. Accordingly, the Cabinet granted its approval in principle to the proposal made by the Acting Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to develop the following multi-modal transport centres on priority basis, subject to carrying out a formal feasibility study, by integrating the bus terminals and railway stations identified as having the highest passenger movement in the Island, with the aim of improving the interconnection of transport modes such as bus, railway and hired vehicle services.Kandy multi-modal transport centre (constructions have been commenced by now under World Bank financing)Anuradhapura (South) multi-modal transport centre (nearing completion under the under the Anuradhapura Integrated Urban Development Project)Anuradhapura (North) multi-modal transport centre (preliminary activities have been completed after carrying out a feasibility study)Multi-modal transport centre centering the Fort Railway Station (has proposed through the ComTrans Master Plan prepared pertaining to urban transport in Colombo and its suburbs)Moratuwa multi-modal transport centre (has proposed through the ComTrans Master Plan)Ragama multi-modal transport centre (has identified through a study conducted by the Japan International Cooperation Agency)Avissawella, Galle, Katunayake, Kurunegala multi-modal transport centres (have identified as per the urban plans of the Urban Development Authority)Gampaha multi-modal transport centre (has identified as per the urban plans of the Urban Development Authority and under the railway electrification activity of the Colombo Suburban Railway Project)Katunayake multi-modal transport centre (has identified under the Airport Development Plan)Kalutara multi-modal transport centre (has identified as per a proposal of the District Coordinating Committee)Kankasanturai multi-modal transport centre (has identified as per the urban plans of the Urban Development Authority)

description: Restructuring of the Housing Development Finance Corporation Bank of Sri Lanka and the Stage Mortgage and Investment Bank
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Housing Development Finance Corporation Bank of Sri Lanka incorporated under the Sri Lanka Housing Development Finance Corporation Bank Act No. 07 of 1997, is a licensed specialized Bank listed on the Colombo Stock Exchange. Its primary objective is to provide housing finance and other services related thereto. The State Mortgage and Investment Bank, established under the State Mortgage and Investment Bank Law No.13 of 1975, is a fully Government-owned licensed specialized Bank, which provides mortgage loan facilities for housing-related purposes. Both these banks are relatively small financial institutions with a small market share. The Central Bank of Sri Lanka has indicated that the current business models of these banks are unsustainable due to their limited deposit-raising capacity, poor profitability, and inability to meet minimum capital adequacy requirements. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to take necessary action, enabling the Bank of Ceylon to acquire the Government’s entire shareholding of the Housing Development Finance Corporation Bank of Sri Lanka to operate as a subsidiary of the Bank of Ceylon and enabling the People's Bank to acquire all shareholdings of the State Mortgage and Investment Bank to operate as a subsidiary of the said Bank, with the objectives of ensuring overall banking sector stability and safeguarding the interests of depositors by enhancing the operational efficiency of the Housing Development Finance Corporation Bank of Sri Lanka and the State Mortgage and Investment Bank, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of an Information Technology Services Subsidiary for the Bank of Ceylon
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Bank of Ceylon has identified the need to strengthen its digitalization capacities in order to respond to evolving customer demands and to remain competitive in the banking sector. Therefore, the Bank has planned to establish an IT subsidiary to the Bank, comprising of qualified IT professionals, to provide Information and Communication Technology solutions and services that will support the optimization of the Bank’s IT operations and digital transformation. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to establish BOC Management and Support Services (Pvt) Ltd., which was established in 1992 to meet the manpower requirements of the Bank of Ceylon and ceased operations in 2007, under the name of BOC IT Solutions (Pvt) Ltd. as a fully-owned subsidiary of the Bank of Ceylon in accordance with the conditions imposed by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procedure of granting provisions for selected project proposals under the ‘National Initiative for Research and Development Commercialization’
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- In order to expedite the implementation of the production economy policy of the present government, a provision of Rs. 01 billion has been allocated in the 2025 Budget for the commercialization of processes that bring forth new ideas, methods, products, services or solutions with a significant positive impact and value through research and development. Accordingly, a dedicated unit called the ‘National Initiative for Research and Development Commercialization' has been established under the Presidential Secretariat, enabling to evaluate the technical and economic potential of the projects and set up a proper investor friendly path for the implementation of those projects thereby contributing to the development of the country. As of now, applications worth about Rs. 2.2 billion have been submitted by local researchers and entrepreneurs to the said unit. The unit has taken steps to prepare a methodology called ‘National Initiative for Research and Development Commercialization' to evaluate project proposals under 02 main phases namely Technical Evaluation and Administrative Evaluation in order to select the most economically, socially and environmentally effective projects from among the applications. Accordingly, measures will be taken to classify unique and essential projects through the proposed evaluation process as well as to identify projects that make a high contribution to economic progress. Based on the viability of the projects selected from the projects thus evaluated, Grants will be provided as follows:

*	The maximum Grant amount is Rs.50 million

*	A Grant amount to a maximum of Rs.10 million will be granted from the approved Grant amount, depending on the viability of the project.

*	The balance provided in addition to the grant amount should be settled as 25% of from the annual net profit after a grace period of one year.

*	The relevant Grant amount will be jointly provided by the Bank of Ceylon and the Department of Development Finance of the General Treasury to the selected researchers and entrepreneurs.

Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to implement the proposed methodology for providing Grants to project proposals selected under the ‘National Initiative for Research and Development Commercialization', was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the National Tariff Policy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2024 06 11, has granted approval for the National Tariff Policy aimed at establishing a transparent and predictable tariff regime to position Sri Lanka as a competitive trade and investment hub. The National Tariff Policy Committee was established on 2025 05 15 to implement the said policy. In the light of the subsequent Government policy amendments, the National Tariff Policy Committee has identified the need to amend certain provisions of the National Tariff Policy to ensure alignment with certain tax legislation and to eliminate ambiguities. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to amend the National Tariff Policy based on the amendments identified accordingly, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into an Agreement with the International Finance Corporation of the World Bank Group to Finance the Secure, Affordable and Sustainable Energy for Sri Lanka Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025 05 07 to obtain a loan facility of US$ 30 million from the International Finance Corporation of the World Bank Group to finance the Secure, Affordable and Sustainable Energy for Sri Lanka Project. Negotiations have been held with the International Finance Corporation of the World Bank Group to obtain the said loan facility. It is also expected to on-lend the said loan facility to the Ceylon Electricity Board or its successor entity/entities. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to enter into an Agreement with the International Finance Corporation of the World Bank Group to obtain a loan facility of US$ 30 million on the financial terms and conditions recommended by the Public Debt Management Office, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into Loan Agreements with the Asian Development Bank for the implementation of the Sustainable Tourism Sector Development Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to implement the Sustainable Tourism Sector Development Programme (STSDP) utilizing funds to be obtained from the Asian Development Bank and to conduct loan negotiations for the same. Accordingly, negotiations have been held to obtain USD 100 million, as USD 70 million Concessional Ordinary Capital Resources and USD 30 million from Regular Ordinary Capital Resources to implement the said Programme under the terms and conditions recommended by the Public Debt Management Office. Required clearance for obtaining the said loan facility has been granted by the Attorney General’s Department and the Central Bank of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to enter into Agreements with the Asian Development Bank to obtain the said loan, enabling to finance the activities of the Sustainable Tourism Sector Development Programme was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No.08 of 2025 for approval of Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025 10 13 for the importation of GR 11/Ponni Samba rice variety, which is equivalent to Kiri Samba rice classified under the HS Code 1006.30.29, without obtaining import control licenses. In order to give effect to the said Cabinet decision, the Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No.08 of 2025, made under the provisions of the Imports and Exports (Control) Act No.1 of 1969, have been published through Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2458/43 dated 2025-10-15. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to submit the said Regulations to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Recruitment of Female Officers to the Posts of Locomotive Driver, Railway Guard, Station Master, and Railway Supervisory Manager in the Department of Sri Lanka Railways
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lankan railway service, which has a history of about 165 years, is a service that operates as a collective effort of the functions assigned to various positions in the Department of Sri Lanka Railways. The posts of Locomotive Driver, Railway Guard, Station Master, and Railway Supervisory Manager under the said Department are essential for maintaining the railway service. Since its inception, the Department of Railways has recruited only male officers for the posts of Locomotive Driver, Railway Guard, Station Master, while female officers have been recruited for the posts of Supervisory Manager only in 2012 and 2015. In accordance with the new economic policies of the government, steps are being taken to provide opportunities for the recruitment of women into the public sector for posts where women have not been recruited so far. Accordingly, taking into account the proposal made by the Acting Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development, it was decided to grant approval, as a matter of policy, in accordance with the powers vested in the Cabinet under the provisions of Article 55(1) of the Constitution, to recruit women officers to the posts of Locomotive Driver, Railway Guard, Station Master, and Railway Supervisory Manager, since provisions have not been made for the recruitment of women officers in the currently approved scheme of recruitment.

description: Purchasing 100 Motorbikes and 50 Three-wheelers for the Special Task Force
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Special Task Force operates 76 main camps, 23 sub-camps and 14 special units covering the entire island. Of the 314 motorcycles currently in the possession to carry out the duties assigned to the Task Force, about 90% are more than 10 years old and are subject to constant technical faults. This situation has become an obstacle to accomplish the special raids carried out by the Special Task Force in a systematic and optimal level. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Security and Parliamentary Affairs to purchase 100 motorcycles with an engine capacity of 125cc and 50 three wheelers for the Special Task Force, enabling to carry out its duties such as combating the menace of drugs and suppressing organized underworld groups efficiently and effectively was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Completion of the remaining construction works of office building projects of District Secretariats and Divisional Secretariats currently under construction and of those that have been suspended midway
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Due to the lack of sufficient space to carry out duties in the District Secretariats and Divisional Secretariats established with the aim of providing public services more efficiently, the construction of several new buildings for District Secretariats and Divisional Secretariats has been initiated during the last several years. Out of them, it has been identified that there are 05 projects which have been partially constructed based on the annual provisions allocated under the expenditure heads of the relevant District Secretaries, and 06 projects in which constructions have been suspended midway due to insufficient provisions. The completion of these projects has been delayed due to the reasons that have generally affected the construction sector in the recent past and the increase in the cost estimates related to the construction of these buildings. Accordingly, taking into account the proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government, approval of the Cabinet was granted for the expeditious completion of the construction works by revising the total cost estimates of the projects in which construction works have been implemented using the provisions of the annual budget estimates, and the inclusion of the projects whose construction works are currently suspended, in the Public Investment Plan and implementation of the same having secured required provisions.

description: Rehabilitation and Improvement of Section from 2+000 km to 3+700 km of the Maharagama – Piliyandala Road
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A Loan Agreement has been entered into with the OPEC Fund for International Development to provide US$ 50 million for the improvement of 46 km length of national roads in the Colombo District. Maharagama-Piliyandala road of 6.7 km length has been identified as the final project under the said loan. One kilometre of the said road has already been improved, and it has been decided to improve the remaining 5.7 km under 03 packages. Accordingly, the improvement of 04 km under sections A and C has already commenced under the provisions of the loan. It has been identified that the funds of the loan are insufficient to improve section B which is the remaining 1.7 km. As such, the proposal made by the Acting Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to renovate 1.7 km of Section B of the Maharagama - Piliyandala road through funds of the Government of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Suspension of implementing new Wind Power Projects in the Mannar Island
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Three (03) Wind Power Projects have been planned for the Mannar Island, which has been identified as an area with high wind potential according to the Countrywide Renewable Resources Extension Plan. The Thambapawani Wind Power Plant, being one among the said projects, has commenced its operations in 2021. The other projects viz.  Windscape Mannar (Pvt) Ltd 20 MW Wind Power Project and the Hayleys Fentons 50 MW Wind Power Plant Project, are scheduled to commence operations in December 2025 and December 2026 respectively. The Cabinet having been apprised by the Minister of Energy that the Hon. President has informed the relevant authorities not to implement new Wind Power Projects on Mannar Island further without the consent of the people in the said island, taking into account the environmental and social issues raised by the people in the area, it was decided to grant the concurrence of the Cabinet to pursue action accordingly.

description: Road Safety Action Plan (2025-2026)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka continues to face a profound and persistent problem of road accidents and loss of life and the average annual fatality rate in the country over the past three years, has been reported as 11.2 per 10,000 due to road accidents. This is well above the safe threshold recommended by the Second Global Decade of Action for Road Safety (2021-2030) and endorsed by the United Nations. According to data and reports of the Department of Police, 118,697 road accidents were reported in the country during the period 2020 - 2024, resulting in 12,322 deaths. Further, it has also been reported that about 400 accidents occur annually due to unprotected railway crossings. Therefore, it has been identified that it is essential to improve the quality of road infrastructure, ensure the use of safe vehicles and regulate those vehicles in order to create a safe and equitable road environment for all road users by reducing the continuous increase of number of deaths and injuries due to road accidents. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Acting Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to implement the 'Road Safety Action Plan 2025 - 2026', which has been prepared with the said objectives, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on the establishment of a Bilateral Consultation Mechanism between Sri Lanka and Uzbekistan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between Sri Lanka and Uzbekistan on the establishment of a Bilateral Consultation Mechanism with a view to expanding cooperation in political, economic, scientific, technical and cultural and tourism sectors. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism to sign the relevant MoU between the two parties, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of the End-User and Handover Agreement between the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) and the Ministry of Defence for the Provision of Satellite Communication Intercept Equipment to the Sri Lanka Navy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime with financial and technical support of the Government of Japan and expertise from the Japan Coast Guard, is implementing the project titled ‘Strengthening Maritime Security and the Rule of Law at Sea in the Indo-Pacific Region’ from 2024. Under the said Project, it has been agreed to provide ‘Cognyte S12’ Satellite Communication Interception System to the Sri Lanka Navy. Enhancing the maritime security activities through preventing, countering and disrupting terrorist activities, organized crimes, drug trafficking and other serious illegal activities are expected through this. Further, this will enable to strengthen the Sri Lanka’s contribution towards regional and international maritime security initiatives. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister Defence to sign the End-User and Handover Agreement between the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime and the Ministry of Defence to obtain the said System to the country, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into Memoranda of Understanding between Sri Lankan Universities and Foreign Universities aimed at Educational Collaboration
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to enter into the following Memoranda of Understanding with a view to enhancing the positions of Sri Lankan universities in global ranking indices and establishing higher educational collaborations with foreign universities for the internationalization, was approved by the Cabinet:

*	Memorandum of Understanding between the University of Peradeniya and the Institute of Geology and Geophysics, Chinese Academy of Sciences, People's Republic of China, valid for a period of 05 years.

*	Memorandum of Understanding between the University of Kelaniya and Bharathidasan University of India, valid for a period of 05 years.

*	Memorandum of Understanding between the University of Moratuwa and the Institute of Multidisciplinary Sciences, Yokohama National University of Japan, valid for a period of 05 years.

*	Memorandum of Understanding between the University of Moratuwa and the National Institute of Technology, Tokuyama College of Japan, valid for a period of 05 years.

description: Selection of an institution for Revamping Currency Operations of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted to execute the procurement process for selecting an institution to revamp the Currency Operations of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, expressions of interest have been invited for the relevant procurement following the two-stage bidding procurement procedure, and four (04) institutions have submitted expressions of interest. Following the evaluation process of the said expressions of interest, proposals have been invited from Giesecke & Devrient Asia Pacific Limited, Hong Kong, which fulfilled the relevant qualifications as per the recommendation of the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee. After evaluating the technical and financial proposals submitted by the said institution, the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee has recommended that the procurement for the revamping the Currency Operations of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka be awarded to the said institution. Based on the said recommendation, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to award the relevant procurement, to Giesecke & Devrient Asia Pacific Limited, Hong Kong, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of space for the establishment of new Courts
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the National Action Plan for Anti-Corruption (2025-2029), the need to establish several new High Courts has been identified as a matter of urgency in order to implement the functions assigned to the Ministry of Justice and National Integration. Accordingly, the Cabinet having been informed by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government that his Ministry will take steps to hand over the buildings located at the following addresses, currently under the custody of the Ministry of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government, to the Ministry of Justice and National Integration, to establish 04 High Courts expeditiously, it was decided to grant the concurrence of the Cabinet for the same:No.B 88, Gregory’s Road, Colombo 07.No.C 76, Baudhdhaloka Mawatha, Colombo 07.No.B 108, Wijerama Road, Colombo 07.No.B 12, Stanmore Cresent, Colombo 07.

description: Appointment to the Post of Commissioner General of Ayurveda
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to appoint Mrs. A.M.G.N Deepthi Sumanasena, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, presently serving as a Commissioner of Labour of the Department of Labour, to the existing vacant Post of Commissioner General of Ayurveda, with immediate effect, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to the Post of Director General of the Department of Animal Production and Health
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Dr. (Mrs) K.A.C.H.A. Kothalawala, presently serving as the Director General of the Department of Animal Production and Health, is scheduled to retire from the Public Service from 2026-02-04, and approval has been granted for her to take leave preparatory to retirement from 2025-11-04 to 2026-02-03. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation to appoint Mr. Kahanda Kanaththage Sarath, Special Grade Officer of the Animal Production and Health Service, presently serving as the Director, Animal Production and Health Department of the Western Provincial Council, to act full-time in the Post of Director General of the Department of Animal Production and Health, during the period Dr. (Mrs) K.A.C.H.A. Kothalawala will be on leave preparatory to retirement and thereafter to appoint him to the post of Director General of the Department of Animal Production and Health on permanent basis, with effect from 2026-02-04, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Recommendations of the Committee appointed to review the Recruitment Process and Cadre Management in the Public Service

decision_details_body:

description: Introduction of a new Act for Licensing of Container Depot Operators and amending the Licensing of Shipping Agents, Freight Forwarders, Non-Vessel Operating Common Carriers and Container Operators Act, No.10 of 1972
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024-12-18 to prepare a Bill for Licensing of Container Depot Operators and to amend the Licensing of Shipping Agents, Freight Forwarders, Non-Vessel Operating Common Carriers and Container Operators Act, No.10 of 1972. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bills prepared by the Legal Draftsman. The proposal made by the Minister of Ports and Civil Aviation to publish the said Bills in the Government Gazette, and thereafter present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Regulations made under the Motor Traffic Act making it compulsory to wear seat belts by passengers in vehicles traveling on expressways
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Motor Traffic (Expressway) Regulations, No. 2 of 2011 made under the provisions of the Motor Traffic Act (Chapter 203) have been amended by the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2455/29 dated 2025-09-25 in order to minimize the number of deaths and serious injuries caused due to the increase of road accidents on expressways daily whereby it has been made mandatory for all seated passengers traveling in a motor vehicle on expressways to wear seat belts.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Acting Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to submit the amended Regulations to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Motor Traffic (Drugs) Regulations, No.01 of 2025 to Parliament for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been stated under the provisions of the Motor Traffic Act that where a police office suspects that any driver on a highway is under the influence of any intoxicating substance, it shall be lawful for such person to be produced before a Government Medical Officer for examination. Nevertheless, Regulations including provisions specifying the procedure and method to be followed in conducting tests for such determination and the threshold level of drug concentration at which a person deemed to have used drugs have not been included. Therefore, the Motor Traffic (Drugs) Regulations No.01 of 2025 have been published under the provisions of the Motor Traffic Act (Chapter 203) through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2452/40 dated 2025-09-04, incorporating provisions to enable to examine the drivers who operate their vehicles under the influence of intoxicating drugs. The proposal made by the Acting Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to submit the said Regulations to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 1,400,000 Bbls +/-5% of Gas Oil (0.05% M.S.) (05 shipments) during the period from 2025-11-15 to 2026-06-14
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Ceylon Petroleum Corporation has invited bids from its registered suppliers to award a term contract for the procurement of 1,400,000 Bbls +/-5% of Gas Oil (0.05% M.S.) (05 shipments), during the period from 2025-11-15 to 2026-06-14. 07 bidders have submitted bids for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Energy to award the said procurement to M/s. Trafigura Pte. Ltd. of Singapore, based on the recommendation of the Standing High Level Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining funds for the Daniel S. Sanders Scholarship Scheme of the National Institute of Social Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The National Institute of Social Development, established under the National Institute of Social Development Act, No.41 of 1992, is an institution authorized by the University Grants Commission to award degrees. In accordance with the provisions of the relevant Act, the Fund of the Institute is empowered to receive any amount by way of donations, gifts or grants from any source within or outside Sri Lanka. Professor Daniel Selvarajah Sanders has served as an early educator in social work at the Institute of Social Work, Sri Lanka, and as a faculty member in the said Institute from 1955-10-01 to 1957-10-03. After his death, Mrs. Christobel C. Sanders, in honour of her late husband, provided funds to start the Professor D. Sanders Endowment Scholarship Scheme of the National Institute of Social Development in the year 1996. 14 students have been awarded scholarships so far through the same. Mrs. Christobel C. Sanders had passed away in 2023, and the Trustee of the late Christobel C. Sanders Trust has informed that a sum of US$ 75,000 remain available for scholarships of the National Institute of Social Development as part of the Trust. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Rural Development, Social Security and Community Empowerment to take further action to formally obtain the said Grant facility offered by the relevant Trust Fund to the National Institute of Social Development and to use the said amount for exemplary performance of social work students and for the improvement of social programmes, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Execution of Projects in the Eastern Province under the Indian Multi Sectoral Grant Assistance for the Eastern Province
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) was signed between the Government of India and the Government of Sri Lanka on 2025-04-05 for implementing projects under the Indian Multi-Sectoral Grant Assistance for the Eastern Province, and the Government of India has agreed to provide a Grant of 2,371.83 million Sri Lankan rupees under the said programme for the implementation of 33 projects to meet the development needs of the Eastern Province. Separate Memoranda of Understanding have to be signed between the High Commission of India and the Ministry of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government in relation to each project to be implemented as per the said MoU. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government for signing of 33 Memoranda of Understanding pertaining to 33 projects by the Secretary to the Ministry of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government with the High Commissioner of India, to be implemented in the Eastern Province under the Indian Multi-Sectoral Grant Assistance, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Utilization of underutilized or partially completed buildings and constructions owned by various Government Institutions for productive purposes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The General Treasury, with the assistance of the Ministry of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government, has gathered Divisional Secretariat Division level information regarding the buildings constructed by various Government institutions, and are either currently abandoned or partially constructed while not being used properly. A report containing details of the current physical condition of 2,972 underutilized and partially constructed buildings identified as per the said information was submitted by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, and the Cabinet decided that the relevant Ministries and Institutions should expeditiously formulate and implement a proper programme enabling to utilize those buildings for productive purposes.

description: Conducting a feasibility study and preparing detailed plans for the extension of the Kelani Valley Railway line beyond Avissawella up to Ratnapura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The 2025 Budget has proposed to extend the existing Kelani Valley Railway Line beyond Avissawella in phases to provide efficient railway services and improve public transport facilities under the modernization of railway transport, and Rs.250 million has been allocated to commence the relevant preliminary works. It has been proposed to reconstruct the said railway line along the previous railway route, and for that purpose, a feasibility study and detailed plans should be expeditiously prepared. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Acting Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to implement the relevant procurement process to select a consultancy service Entity for the said purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing the United Nations Convention against Cybercrime
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The United Nations Convention against Cybercrime (UNCC) adopted at the 55th plenary session of the United Nations General Assembly in December 2024, is a global approach designed to address a range of serious cybercrimes. Joining the new Convention will enable Sri Lanka to achieve benefits such as preventing and combating cyber-enabled crimes, strengthening cooperation, recovering assets, protecting witnesses and victims, and developing technical assistance and capacity building. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as Minister of Digital Economy; the Minister of Justice and National Integration; and the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism to sign the United Nations Convention against Cybercrime, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to the Post of Director General of the Department of National Planning
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Post of Director General of the Department of National Planning has fallen vacant, due to the retirement of Mrs. J.M.S.D.Rathnayake, who served as the Director General of the said Department, from the public service on 2025‑09‑21. Applications had been called from the Special Grade Officers of the Sri Lanka Planning Service to identify a suitable officer to the said post. Accordingly, based on the recommendations of the Interview Board, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to appoint Mr. K.T.I Premaratne, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Planning Service, to the post of Director General of the Department of National Planning, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the International Telecommunications Operators Levy (Imposition) Regulations, No.1 of 2020, to Parliament for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - With the imposition of the Regulations published through the Government Gazette in terms of section 22(1) of the Finance Act, No.11 of 2004, the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development is vested with the power to prescribe the rate of International Telecommunications Operators Levy. Accordingly, the International Telecommunications Operators Levy (Imposition) Regulation No.1 of 2010 published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.1662/1 dated 2010‑07-12, which was last amended by the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2312/80 dated 2023‑01-01, has been further amended by the Gazette Extraordinary Notification 2430/14 dated 2025‑04-01. The proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to submit the said amended Regulation to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to the Post of Surveyor General
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Mr. Y.G. Gnanathilaka, who served as the Surveyor General in the Survey Department of Sri Lanka, has retired from the Public Service on 2025-10-01. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation to appoint Mr. N.K.U. Rohana, Additional Surveyor General, the most Senior of the Special Grade of the Sri Lanka Surveyors Service, to the vacant post of Surveyor General, with immediate effect, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Poisons, Opium and Dangerous Drugs (Amendment) Bill and the Judicature (Amendment) Bill (Prohibition against trafficking of dangerous drugs on high seas) to Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025‑06­‑23 to amend the Poisons, Opium and Dangerous Drugs Ordinance, No. 17 of 1929, introducing the provisions on the trafficking of dangerous drugs on the high seas and other consequential amendments, and to amend the Judicature Act, No. 2 of 1978, to confer the High Court of Sri Lanka the forum jurisdiction to hear and determine criminal prosecutions on indictment for offences committed by any person on the high seas. Accordingly, the relevant Bills have been prepared by the Legal Draftsman and the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the said Bills. The proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to publish the said Bills in the Government Gazette and thereafter present those in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Preparation of a new Act to meet the contemporary requirements by repealing the Post Office Security Fund Ordinance, No.1 of 1931
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted to amend the Post Office Security Fund Ordinance, at the Cabinet meeting held on 2022‑03‑07. Since it has been proposed to totally amend certain sections of the said Ordinance and to insert new sections, it has been found more appropriate to introduce a new Act to suit the present needs, instead of further amending the said Ordinance. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to instruct the Legal Draftsman to repeal the Post Office Security Fund Ordinance No.1 of 1931 (Chapter 282) and prepare a new Bill, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Strategic Development Projects Act, No.14 of 2008
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - At the Cabinet meeting held on 2025‑07‑07, Policy approval of the Cabinet has been granted to amend the Strategic Development Projects Act, No.14 of 2008. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 1,900,000 Vials of Meropenem Injection 1g Vial
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - International competitive bids have been invited for the purchase of the Meropenem Injection, a drug used to treat a wide range of severe bacterial infections. Six (06) bids have been received for the same. Accordingly, based on the recommendation of the Standing High Level Procurement Committee, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the procurement for the supply of 1,900,000 Vials of Meropenem Injection 1g Vial, to United Biotech (Pvt) Ltd, India (Manufacturer: United Biotech (Pvt) Ltd, India), the substantially responsive lowest bidder, for a sum of USD1.99 million including total cost and freight charges, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for the supply of modern printing machinery and equipment to the Department of Government Printing
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Department of Government Printing undertakes all confidential and other printing tasks of the Government of Sri Lanka with the assured quality while upholding utmost confidentiality and responsibility while facing competitive open market conditions. However, the Department of Government Printing has to face challenges such as inadequacy of modern printing machinery and equipment, frequent breakdowns in the functionality of machines, involving a high maintenance cost, and high labor utilization. Accordingly, a development project has been planned to be implemented to achieve the objectives of increasing the capacity of printing activities through the purchase and operation of modern printing machinery and equipment, establishing a secure environment for carrying out printing activities, and competing effectively in printing activities with non-government sectors. The proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to implement the said project during the period 2026 – 2030, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of a Project for Manufacturing of Assistive Devices Locally
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to expand the facilities for manufacturing of assistive devices for differently abled persons locally under the 2025 Budget. Accordingly, Rs.500 million has been allocated for the implementation of a project in the Rheumatology and Rehabilitation Hospital, Ragama and the Sri Lanka National Hospital. This project is expected to be implemented with the components such as upgrading the services of providing assistive devices at the Rheumatology and Rehabilitation Hospital, Ragama and improving the facilities for manufacturing of assistive devices locally under the Accident and Orthopedic Service of the National Hospital of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to implement the said project using provisions of  Rs.630.2 million within the Medium Term Budgetary Framework 2025-2027, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Re-construction of the Kurikadduwan Jetty, Kayts Divisional Secretariat Division of the Jaffna District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Kurikadduwan Jetty serves as the main maritime access point connecting the Jaffna Peninsula with both Nainativu (Nagadeepa) and Delft (Neduntheevu) islands. The jetty facilitates passenger and cargo ferry services to the said islands and serves a wide range of social, religious, economic and administrative functions. The existing jetty has suffered extensive structural damages due to the prolonged exposure to marine conditions and lack of major renovation. Recognizing the importance of the jetty for transportation, religious tourism and regional development, the proposal made by the Acting Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to implement the Kurikadduwan Jetty construction project under the Medium Term Budgetary Framework, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of a Project for Rehabilitation and Maintenance of Mitigated Landslides
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Various slope stabilization projects have been implemented so far to mitigate landslide risk situations at identified locations by the National Building Research Organization. Accordingly, approximately 250 slope stabilization projects have been implemented in the past 10 years, and nearly 10 billion Rupees have been spent for the same. The long-term stability of a mitigated landslide depends on the measures taken to manage the subsurface and surface drainage patterns. Without proper maintenance, the failure to manage these drainage patterns can cause previously mitigated locations to become unstable again. Therefore, it is imperative to carry out proper maintenance activities to prevent such instability that may occur at a mitigated landslide site. Although a set of guidelines have been issued by the National Building Research Organization to the relevant stakeholder institutions for this purpose, threats of instability at previously mitigated sites have arisen due to the failure of those institutions to carry out proper maintenance activities. In order to prevent the risks that may arise due to that situation, the recommendation of the Department of National Planning has been received for a project planned by the National Building Research Organization called ‘Rehabilitation and Maintenance of Mitigated Landslides'.  The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to implement the said project during the period 2026 – 2030, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Delineation of Total Impact Zones of Potential Landslides based on Red and Yellow Zone Methodology
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that the mountainous area, which constitutes about 30% of the total land area of ​​the country spreading over 14 districts, is at risk of landslides. Landslide hazard zonation maps are developed and utilized by the National Building Research Organization as a primary tool for the early identification of landslide-prone slopes of hills and their distribution. Accordingly, landslide hazard zone maps had been prepared covering most of the landslide-prone areas in Sri Lanka by the year 2023. Such zone maps only indicate areas, susceptible for landslide initiations. However, in landslide risk management, it is essential to identify the entire area that may be affected by a landslide, including the landslide initiation zone, debris flow path and depositional areas. Recognizing that situation, the National Building Research Organization has proposed a project titled 'Delineation of Total Impact Zones of Potential Landslides based on Red and Yellow Zone Methodology'. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to implement the said project, taking into account the urgent need to minimize the risk of landslide disasters in the island, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Programme for providing a pair of footwear each for the selected School Students, Lay and Clergy Students of Pirivenas and Seela Mathas for the year 2026
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- It has been decided to provide vouchers for obtaining a pair of footwear to the selected school students, lay and clergy students of Pirivenas and Seela Mathas for the year 2026, to the beneficiaries by the end of the school term 2025. It has been planned to securely print those vouchers with a QR code enabling to scan through the Gift Vouchers mobile application developed by the Ministry of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to grant welfare benefits and provide the same to beneficiary students. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to select students as follows under the said programme, was approved by the Cabinet:

644,000 students studying in schools with less than 250 students across the Island.
53,093 students studying in Estate schools with 251-500 students.
2,300 students in 30 schools where students with special needs are studying.
selected 30,000 lay/clergy students in Pirivenas.

description: Printing of Textbooks/Modules from the State Printing Corporation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2025‑06‑16, granted approval to award the contract for printing 40% of the total number of textbooks/modules to be printed for free distribution to school students for the year 2026, to the State Printing Corporation as a direct procurement. The price of the textbooks/modules to be provided to the State Printing Corporation for printing has to be determined based on the lowest evaluated price of the bidder selected under the National Competitive Procurement Methodology for the printing of textbooks/modules. The bidders selected under the National Competitive Procurement Methodology have already been awarded the printing of the relevant textbooks/modules. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to award the contract for printing 6.04 million copies of 78 types of textbooks/modules to the State Printing Corporation for a sum of Rs. 761.29 million (excluding VAT) based on the prices submitted by the substantially responsive lowest evaluated bidder, was approved by the Cabinet.
